metadata.name: TypeFighter Procedural Stickman Skeletal Rig
metadata.author: Stickman Animation Engineer
metadata.description: Procedural 16-joint skeletal animation rig with keyframe martial arts animations, hitboxes, motion trails, and color themes.

joints.name: Hips
joints.description: Pelvic root joint. Master translation and tilt anchor.

joints.name: Torso
joints.description: Main spine / torso column extending upward from hips.

joints.name: Neck
joints.description: Neck joint linking upper torso to head.

joints.name: Head
joints.description: Head skull with directional eye visor and combat headband.

joints.name: Left Shoulder
joints.description: Left shoulder / upper arm joint (front lead arm).

joints.name: Right Shoulder
joints.description: Right shoulder / upper arm joint (rear power arm).

joints.name: Right Hip
joints.description: Right hip / thigh joint (rear power leg).

idle.name: idle
idle.description: Breathing cycle with rhythmic torso bobbing and relaxed martial arts guard.

punch_jab.name: punch_jab
punch_jab.description: Lightning-fast left jab with 2 startup frames, 1 active impact frame, and 3 recovery frames.

punch_straight.name: punch_straight
punch_straight.description: Powerful right cross driving kinetic force through hip rotation and lead foot plant.

roundhouse_kick.name: roundhouse_kick
roundhouse_kick.description: Explosive spinning roundhouse kick with high-speed swoosh arc and counterbalance lean.

uppercut.name: uppercut
uppercut.description: Rising vertical uppercut exploding skyward from a deep crouch, launching targets upward.

air_juggle.name: air_juggle
air_juggle.description: Rapid aerial kick combo executed in mid-air keeping airborne opponents juggled.

ground_slam.name: ground_slam
ground_slam.description: Devastating downward axe kick slamming from maximum altitude into the canvas with expanding shockwave.

hit_reaction.name: hit_reaction
hit_reaction.description: Head snapback and body recoil with backward stumble upon taking damage.

knockdown.name: knockdown
knockdown.description: Devastating knockdown blowing fighter off feet, crashing back-first onto the canvas with head bounce.

victory_pose.name: victory_pose
victory_pose.description: Triumphant victory pose with high skyward fist pump and pulsating radiant aura.
